prompt:
Create ONE polished enemy character selection concept sheet for a first-person music-fantasy survival roguelite. Landscape 16:9. Exactly EIGHT DISTINCT full-body enemy designs in a clean FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid. Each character has its own equal-sized cell, consistent rendering, generous separation, pale warm ivory plain background, subtle grounding shadow, and one large readable number 01 to 08 beneath it, left to right top row then bottom row. No other text. No overlapping characters, no cropped feet, no environment, no HUD, no infographic arrows, no attacks obscuring designs. This is a selection sheet, not a battle scene or a scale lineup. Make all eight silhouettes highly distinct, at approximately equal visual importance; fit the complete design inside each cell.

ART DIRECTION: retro hand-painted Japanese animation translated into clean appealing 3D cel-shaded game character concepts. Crisp refined ink contours, expressive angular shapes, decisive two or three tone hard shadows, restrained matte painted texture, warm ivory, antique gold, burgundy, midnight indigo, muted teal accents. Charming but clearly hostile mischievous music-fantasy creatures, suitable for a whimsical elegant adventure. Not photorealistic, not chibi mascots, not generic steampunk robots. Actual acoustic instrument anatomy and readable playable silhouettes; modest fantasy details, buildable shapes. Music is the broad theme, not limited to theater occupations: living instruments, resonance spirits, rhythm creatures, sheet-music entities. No guns, sci-fi armor, circuitry, speakers, neon equalizers, gore, strings hanging from the image border, or stage sets.

01 STRING DUELIST: slender animated violin-bodied wooden puppet, carved violin torso with two unmistakable f-holes and taut strings, elegant dark articulated limbs, small ivory half-mask, burgundy scarf and swept narrow head silhouette, holds a single curved violin bow low at its side. Aggressive poised duelist stance, readable anatomy, not a human holding a violin.
02 DRUM SCARAB: broad squat beetle-like creature whose round armored back is a large red marching bass drum with ivory drumskin and brass tension rods; six sturdy dark legs, small menacing face under the rim, two thick drumstick-shaped forelimbs. Heavy compact oval silhouette, not another humanoid.
03 HORN HOUND: lean four-legged hunting hound made from a continuous flowing polished brass French-horn body, coiled torso tubing, flared trumpet-bell muzzle, dark clawed feet, burgundy ribbon at neck. Elegant animal anatomy with long curved body, ready-to-pounce stance; instrument structure feels organic and mythical rather than mechanical.
04 CHIME MEDUSA: floating translucent indigo jellyfish spirit with a small ornate golden handbell dome, visible ivory inner face and suspended bell clapper, a few long silk-like cyan resonance tendrils and tiny chimes. Clear rounded floating top and tapering ribbons, no human legs. Limit glow so its shape remains visible.
05 ACCORDION TRICKSTER: compact theatrical imp with red-and-ivory accordion bellows for a wide expandable torso, piano keys on one flank and round buttons on the other, two expressive gloved hands, short curved boots, split jester collar and a sly angular face. Distinct horizontal zigzag silhouette, mischievous and dangerous; not generic clown makeup.
06 TUNING-FORK HERON: tall thin spectral wading bird with a giant unmistakable U-shaped tuning fork rising as its head and neck, narrow dark body, folded fanlike metallic feather wings and two long elegant legs. Teal resonance core between fork prongs, restrained soft accent, nonhumanoid vertical silhouette.
07 LOST-SCORE WRAITH: asymmetric floating manta-like entity formed from folded ivory sheet music, curled paper fins with sparse visible musical notation, dark hollow center containing two small amber eyes, winding staff-line ribbon tail. Sharp torn-but-clean origami edges, a few detached paper fragments close to the body. Readably paper, not a fabric ghost, no hands or feet.
08 METRONOME WARDEN: imposing angular upright guardian, wooden pyramidal metronome body as torso, central brass pendulum and beat scale clearly visible, two long coatlike wooden side panels, wide ivory shoulder collar, small stern mask inset near the top, heavy dark boots and two long conductor-baton arms. Stately threatening posture, taller character proportions, strongest triangular silhouette. Antique polished wood, not sci-fi robot.

Make a coherent family in the same palette while maintaining radically different proportions, materials, locomotion and silhouette. Strong readable shape design prioritized over ornamental detail. Tiny restrained posture cues may suggest personality, but do not write ability names or dictate gameplay mechanics. Only the eight number labels 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08.
